name: TurtleBot3 Burger
author: Henosync Team — Monash University
description: TurtleBot3 Burger via rosbridge. VICON or GPS positioning. Simple goto controller for movement.

namespace.label: ROS2 Namespace
namespace.description: Leave blank if using a single robot with no namespace.

position_source.label: Positioning Source
position_source.description: VICON: position from motion capture. GPS: onboard GPS receiver.

vicon_host.label: VICON PC Host
vicon_host.description: IP address of the PC running VICON Tracker.

vicon_object_name.label: VICON Object Name
vicon_object_name.description: Must exactly match the rigid body name in VICON Tracker.

home_lat.label: Arena Origin Latitude
home_lat.description: WGS84 latitude of the VICON arena origin (X=0, Y=0).

home_lon.label: Arena Origin Longitude
home_lon.description: WGS84 longitude of the VICON arena origin (X=0, Y=0).

gps_topic.label: GPS Topic
gps_topic.description: ROS2 topic publishing sensor_msgs/NavSatFix. Leave blank for /gps/fix.
